website.readmeExcerpt:
# Komos

![Downloads](https://img.shields.io/github/downloads/RoseOfficial/Komos/total)

Keep FFXIV festival scenery around all year — client-side.

Komos lets you pick, per zone, which seasonal event scenery stays visible: the
Moonfire Faire pleasure cruise in August-forever, Starlight lights in your
favorite city, or any past event whose decorations still ship in the game
files. When a live event ends, Komos offers to keep it running for you.

## What it does

- Per-zone festival picker: only shows festivals that actually have scenery in
  the zone you are standing in, with phase selection.
- Survives zoning, teleports, and relogs; restores the real state when disabled.
- Event extender: when a live event ends, every zone that holds its scenery gets a
  Keep button in the window (or `/komos keep <id>` from chat).
- Preset codes: share your loadout so friends running Komos see the same scene.
- `/komos` opens the window; `/komos help` lists chat commands.

## What it does not do

- Other players cannot see your scenery unless they run Komos with the same
  preset — this is a purely client-side, visual tool.
- Event NPCs, vendors, quests, and minigames are server-side and do not return.

## Installation

Komos ships through the Olympus plugin repository. In Dalamud, open Settings →
Experimental → Custom Plugin Repositories, add

    https://raw.githubusercontent.com/RoseOfficial/Olympus/main/repo.json

save, then install Komos from the plugin installer. If you already use Olympus,
the repository is already there and Komos simply appears in the list.

To build a sideload copy instead, run a Release build of `src/Komos/Komos.csproj`;
the ready-to-install zip lands at `src/Komos/bin/Release/Komos/latest.zip`.

## Safety notes

Komos only ever changes which festival layers your own game client displays,
using the same mechanism the game itself uses. It never sends anything to the
server. It stands down automatically after game patches until its libraries
update, and pauses itself in duties by default.

As with any third-party tool, use Komos at your own discretion and avoid
discussing plugins in-game.

variant.author: RoseOfficial
variant.changelog:
### Fixed
- The event extender offers to keep an ended event only in zones that hold its scenery, and each such zone gets its own offer; before, whichever zone you stood in consumed the only offer, even with nothing there to keep
- A queued scenery change that the game applied late, after Komos had stopped waiting for it, is no longer mistaken for server scenery, so disabling Komos restores the real server state in that case too

### New
- Keep and Dismiss buttons in the window for ended events; the chat command still works
- Zone names in the window and in chat replies instead of bare territory numbers
- The installer listing now carries the release notes and a category
